sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 15 (sheet row 16), Internal Quality Checks row 15 (no annotation), Deterministic Checks check-dockerfiles.py, check-dockerfile-references.sh, check-fixtures.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py, check-dockerfile-sanity.sh
evidence: Source review of frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r11/task). environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (same sha256), so the template-controlled agent image is preserved. Pinned: line 1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (versioned major+distro tag, same as template; no digest, which the workbook/skill and check-dockerfiles.py treat as pinned base); line 9-11 `npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1` exact versions; apt packages unpinned (ca-certificates git procps sqlite3) which check-dockerfiles.py treats as NOTE only. Runtime deps pre-installed: solution requires only express (src/index.js:18), better-sqlite3 (src/db.js:7) and node built-ins (fs, path, crypto, http, worker_threads); solution/app/package.json pins exactly express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 matching the global install; Dockerfile line 3 `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules` makes them resolvable. instruction.md:13 says 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages' and environment/instructions/integration.md:3-4,18-19 tells the agent to use NODE_PATH; solve.sh performs no install (only copies app and resets DB). tests/Dockerfile:16-21 installs the same two versions with the same NODE_PATH, so the dependency set matches at grade time. Assets staged: lines 14-16 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/`, `COPY assets/ /assets/`, `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets`; environment/instructions holds hireops_rules.md and integration.md, both referenced by instruction.md:11; environment/assets/seed_data.json is referenced by instruction.md:13 and is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json. /app created, git-initialised and contains only .gitkeep (lines 17-23); no COPY of solution/ or tests/. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image, build_timeout_sec=600 unchanged from template. Counterexample probes: (a) a broken app that runs npm install at startup or depends on an unlisted package is not enabled by this Dockerfile and is forbidden publicly; it would fail at grade time, which is a fair failure, not a row defect. (b) a conforming alternative using only express/better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH plus optional CDN front-end assets (allowed under public network, instruction.md:13) resolves in both images; I found no conforming dependency the image omits. Measurement gap noted, not waived: the raw-evidence index for this round lists only scripted golden runs in the verifier image (hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair); no agent-image build log is indexed, so the agent image build itself was not measured in this round. Because the bytes equal the shared template, any build failure would be template-level. Not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score.
